data.summary: Beispiel Direktversicherung AG issued a new car liability and partial comprehensive (Teilkasko) insurance policy for vehicle MB-TB 318, with coverage starting on 15 March 2027. The annual premium of €486.20 will be debited automatically from the customer's account at the start of coverage.
data.explanation: This letter confirms your new car insurance policy (Haftpflicht plus Teilkasko with €150 deductible), starting 15 March 2027. The annual premium of €486.20 will be taken automatically from your account, so no payment action is needed from you now. The contract runs for one year and then renews automatically for another year unless you cancel it in text form (letter, fax or email) at least one month before the end of an insurance year — the app will show you the relevant window when it becomes relevant. Keep this document for your records; check the vehicle, coverage and premium details are correct, and contact the insurer if anything looks wrong.
